content_metadata.description: This video discusses privacy concerns in the digital age, focusing on unintentional privacy erosion through social media and photography.

qAndA.question: What social convention does Vint Cerf suggest might be eroded in the online world?

qAndA.answer: Taking and uploading photos to social media, inadvertently capturing and sharing images of people who did not consent to being photographed.
